title: Final Velocities BC
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final velocity of the center of mass of rod BC as (0, -P/(4m)).

title: Final Velocities AB
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final velocity of the center of mass of rod AB as (0, 5P/(4m)).

title: Angular Velocities
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the angular velocities as theta1_dot = 3P/(2ma) and theta2_dot = -9P/(2ma).

title: Use of Impulse
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the impulse and its effects on the system's motion.

title: Kinetic Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct expression for the total kinetic energy of the system.

title: Lagrange's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up and apply Lagrange's equations for impulsive motion.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the equations derived from Lagrange's equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
